findings.message: a3 calls Bhava 'an old name of Śiva', citing mw-bhava p. 749. The excerpt (research/vedasara-shiva-stava/v3/sources/mw-bhava.md, p. 749,1) is more careful. In the AV, Bhava is 'a deity attending on Rudra and frequently connected with Śarva', and the excerpt calls it a '(later N. of Śiva or a form of Śiva)'. So the name is old, but the excerpt dates its use for Śiva as later. The claim may be slightly stronger than the source. A human should decide whether the wording needs to change.
findings.suggested_fix: e.g. 'Bhava, an ancient name that came to mean Śiva, from bhū, to be, to become' (hi: 'भव, एक प्राचीन नाम जो आगे चलकर शिव का नाम बना, भू (होना, बनना) से')
